authorized_edits: Allow one explicit upper-bound comparison before the store and a branch to the existing negative-index message path; no new allocation, no realloc.
Allow up to 128 bytes of added x86-64 code in a verified-unused region of an R-X PT_LOAD reachable from the store site.
Allow up to 64 bytes of added read-only data holding the invalid-index message, RIP-relative references only.
Allow the invalid path to write that message to fd 2 and exit 1 without the ten printIntLine calls.
Allow no new segment, dynamic import, GOT/PLT edit or permission broadening.
environment_assumptions: stdin is a regular pipe carrying one line of digits
glibc malloc chunk metadata sits immediately after the 40-byte payload
forbidden_behavior: write outside the 10*sizeof(int) heap allocation, i.e. accept an index of 10 or more and store through buffer[index]
invalid_input_response: print the recorded stderr line and exit 1 without printing the buffer
valid_behavior: store 1 at buffer[index], then print the ten integers one per line
valid_domain: decimal integers 0..9 on stdin; the ten-element heap buffer is indexed with the value read, and every index inside 0..9 is writable
